loftia-jump-to-content: Text of the skip link that lets keyboard users jump past the header to the page content.
loftia-page-tools: Accessible label for the row of page tabs (Page, Discussion, Edit, History and the More menu).
loftia-user-menu: Label of the dropdown in the header that holds the personal tools (log in, preferences, log out).
loftia-theme-toggle: Fallback label for the header button that switches between the light and dark colour themes.
loftia-theme-os: Tooltip of the theme button while the wiki follows the device's light or dark setting.
loftia-theme-day: Tooltip of the theme button while the light theme is selected.
loftia-theme-night: Tooltip of the theme button while the dark theme is selected.
loftia-disclaimer: Footer notice that the wiki is an unofficial fan project. Keep the copyright holder's name (Qloud Games) unchanged.
